_comment: A facts.table_sources block stored by a report written between a5c40e70 and ca763a01 (replica_read_count, older risk wording, no shares_replica_risk), and the block the /results API serves after src/report/facts.py fills it in. tests/unit/report/test_sources_of_truth_section.py checks the engineering report prints the expected text; components/__tests__/SourcesOfTruthCallout.test.js checks the results page prints the same.

replicated_tables.risk: Eventually consistent: 3 reads on Aurora MySQL read a copy kept in sync from DynamoDB via CDC, so each sees a write only after CDC applies it, behind by the replication lag; a read that must see its own write should read from DynamoDB.
Eventually consistent: 2 reads on Aurora MySQL (q1, q2) read a copy kept in sync from DynamoDB via CDC, so a read can miss a write until it replicates.
